Salesforce capture, 2026-11-09. The namespace case used an authorized Developer org with the synthetic namespace shown in the rows. The unmanaged control used a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org. The Account field-set metadata and anonymous Apex are in project/. Two field sets were deployed for the namespace case; only CodexC163Capture was deployed for the unmanaged control. The same Apex was executed through anonymous Apex at API 62.0 and 67.0. The outcomes transcribe the JSON emitted by System.debug. Both executions compiled and succeeded in each org. Namespace metadata deletion succeeded after capture. Scratch-org deletion succeeded and a subsequent alias lookup returned NamedOrgNotFoundError.
After the initial cleanup, both field sets were redeployed to the same authorized namespaced org, and project/lookup.apex was run anonymously at both API versions. Each execution compiled and succeeded. The observed lookup and cardinality results are appended in org.tsv. The two field sets have distinct local names; this does not establish collision behavior across namespaces.
The second metadata deletion succeeded; a subsequent API 67.0 anonymous probe found no remaining probe keys.
A synthetic custom object and its field set were then deployed in the same namespaced org. The source is project/custom-lookup.apex and project/force-app/main/default/objects/CodexC163Object__c/. Anonymous execution compiled and succeeded at API 62.0 and 67.0; org.tsv records the observed key and lookup results. The custom object metadata deletion succeeded, and an API 67.0 global-describe lookup subsequently returned false for its qualified name.
